title: Count in hundreds and thousands
description: Count in hundreds and thousands within 10,000.

title: Use notation, representations and place value to 10,000
description: Interpret thousands, hundreds, tens and ones in numbers up to 10,000 using notation and representations.

title: Read and write numbers to 10,000
description: Read and write numbers up to 10,000 in numerals and words.

title: Compare and order numbers to 10,000
description: Compare and order numbers within 10,000.

title: Recognise number-sequence patterns
description: Describe and continue patterns in number sequences.

title: Add and subtract up to four digits
description: Use addition and subtraction algorithms with numbers up to four digits.

title: Solve addition and subtraction word problems
description: Solve up to two-step word problems involving addition and subtraction.
readinessEvidence: Solves one-step addition/subtraction contexts and identifies the whole, parts or compared quantities.
masteryEvidence: Chooses part-whole or comparison structure independently.
Represents a two-step relationship before calculating.
Explains what each bar segment and operation represents in the story.

title: Mentally add and subtract two-digit numbers
description: Mentally add and subtract two two-digit numbers.

title: Use multiplication tables of 6, 7, 8 and 9
description: Build and recall multiplication facts for 6, 7, 8 and 9.

title: Multiply and divide within multiplication tables
description: Multiply and divide within the learned multiplication tables.

title: Divide with remainder
description: Divide quantities where a remainder may result and interpret the remainder.

title: Multiply and divide up to three digits by one digit
description: Use multiplication and division algorithms with numbers up to three digits by one digit.

title: Solve four-operation word problems
description: Solve up to two-step word problems involving the four operations.
readinessEvidence: Solves one-step multiplication/division and addition/subtraction word problems and identifies the quantity relationships.
masteryEvidence: Selects operations from the represented relationships rather than keywords.
Chooses an appropriate part-whole or comparison model when a bar model is useful.
Labels known and unknown quantities correctly and explains a two-step solution.

title: Mentally multiply and divide known facts
description: Mentally multiply and divide within the learned multiplication tables.

title: Recognise equivalent fractions
description: Recognise fractions that represent the same value.
readinessEvidence: Represents the same whole partitioned into equal parts and compares unit/like fractions.
masteryEvidence: Identifies equivalent fractions from visual models and symbols.
Explains why two fraction names refer to the same quantity using a common whole.

title: Express a fraction in simplest form
description: Express a fraction in an equivalent simplest form.
readinessEvidence: Recognises equivalent fractions and can identify a common factor in simple numerator/denominator pairs.
masteryEvidence: Reduces fractions within the P3 number range to simplest form accurately.
Explains that numerator and denominator are divided by the same factor to preserve value.

title: Compare and order unlike fractions
description: Compare and order unlike fractions with denominators of the given fractions not exceeding 12.
readinessEvidence: Compares unit and like fractions and recognises equivalent fractions.
masteryEvidence: Compares and orders unlike fractions within denominator 12 across varied examples.
Uses a visual model, number line or equivalent fractions to justify an ordering.
Rejects numerator-only and denominator-only comparison rules and explains why.

title: Generate an equivalent fraction from a given numerator or denominator
description: Write an equivalent fraction when either the target numerator or denominator is given.
readinessEvidence: Recognises equivalent fraction pairs and multiplies/divides within the P2 tables.
masteryEvidence: Finds the scale factor from a given numerator or denominator.
Applies the same factor to numerator and denominator and explains why the fraction value is unchanged.

title: Add and subtract related fractions
description: Add and subtract two related fractions within one whole with denominators of given fractions not exceeding 12.
readinessEvidence: Adds and subtracts like fractions and can generate an equivalent fraction for a related denominator.
masteryEvidence: Converts related fractions to compatible parts before addition/subtraction when needed.
Calculates accurately within one whole and explains the operation with a representation.

title: Add and subtract money in decimal notation
description: Add and subtract money amounts written in decimal notation.

title: Measure kilometres and millilitres
description: Measure length in kilometres and liquid volume in millilitres.

title: Measure in compound units
description: Measure length, mass and liquid volume using compound units.

title: Convert compound metric measures
description: Convert between compound and smaller units for kilometres/metres, metres/centimetres, kilograms/grams, and litres/millilitres using easy-to-manipulate numbers.

title: Measure time in seconds
description: Measure time intervals in seconds.

title: Find starting time, finishing time or duration
description: Find one of starting time, finishing time or duration when the other two quantities are known.

title: Use the 24-hour clock
description: Read, write and interpret time using the 24-hour clock.

title: Understand area and perimeter
description: Distinguish the concepts of area and perimeter of a plane figure.

title: Measure area in square units
description: Measure area in square units, square centimetres and square metres, excluding conversion between cm² and m².

title: Find perimeter of rectilinear figures, rectangles and squares
description: Determine perimeter for rectilinear figures, rectangles and squares.

title: Find area of rectangles and squares
description: Calculate the area of rectangles and squares.

title: Understand the concept of angle
description: Recognise and reason about angles as geometric quantities.

title: Compare angles with a right angle
description: Identify right angles and angles greater than or smaller than a right angle.

title: Identify perpendicular and parallel lines
description: Identify perpendicular and parallel lines.

title: Draw perpendicular and parallel lines
description: Draw perpendicular and parallel lines.

title: Read and interpret bar graphs
description: Read and interpret data from bar graphs.

title: Use different scales on axes
description: Read and interpret bar graphs that use different scales on an axis.
